summary: Shri Suhael Bhuttan, Advocate, AMPIN Ms. Pallavi Saigal, Advocate, CTUIL ORDER The AMPIN Energy Green Private Limited (formerly known as AMP Energy Green private Limited) (“AMPIN Green”) and AMPIN Energy Green Three Private Limited (“AMPIN Three”) (hereinafter referred to as the “Petitioners”) had filed the present Petition seeking extension of Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (SCOD) for 50 MW Wind- Solar Hybrid Project having connectivity at Fatehgarh-lV ISTS Pooling Station until 28.02.2026 and consequent waiver from payment of ISTS Charges under Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 (hereinafter referred to as the “2020 Sharing regulations”). The Petitioners have made the following prayers: (a) Allow the present Petition. (b) Approve the Recommendation Report of the CERC Committee dated 26.03.2026 in respect of the Petitioner's 50 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid Project; (c) Grant extension of the Project’s Scheduled Commercial Operation Date until the actual Commercial Operation Date being 28.02.2026; (d) Hold and declare that the Petitioner is entitled to a 100% waiver of Inter-State Transmission System charges as if the project had achieved COD on or before 30.06.2025 in terms of Office Order dated 30.07.2025 (and addendum thereto); AND/OR (e) Pass any such further order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case. Submission by the Petitioner: 2. The Petitioners have mainly submitted as under: (a) The present Petition has been filed seeking extension of SCOD until 28.02.2026, for the purpose of waiver of Inter-State Transmission System (“ISTS”) charges for 50 MW Project under Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the 2020 Sharing Regulations read with Office Order dated 30.07.2025 and Addendum dated 14.01.2026 issued by this Commission. (b) This Commission has constituted a “Committee for recommending Extension of Time in SCOD for the specific projects” (“Committee”) to conduct a prudence check of the applications submitted by Renewable Energy Generating Station ("REGS") and to recommend whether a project is entitled to the extension of SCOD as sought, in cases Order in Petition No. 228/MP/2026 Page 2 (q) In light of the above, AMPIN Green is fully entitled to the benefit of extension of SCOD and the consequential waiver of ISTS charges, as if the Project had achieved COD within the originally stipulated timelines. Hearing dated 25.05.2026 3. The extracts of the RoP for the hearing dated 25.05.2026 are as under: “The learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that the present Petition has been filed seeking extension of the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date for the Petitioners’ 50 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid Project having connectivity at Fatehgarh lV ISTS Pooling Station until 28.02.2026 and consequent waiver from payment of the ISTS Charges under Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) (Fourth Amendment) Regulations, 2025 read with this Commission’s Office Order dated 30.07.2025 and its addendum dated 14.01.2026 and Committee Recommendation Report dated 26.03.2026. 2. After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission directed as under: (a) Admit and issue notice to the Respondent. (b) The Respondent to file its reply, if any, within two weeks with a copy to the Petitioners, who may file their rejoinder, if any, within a week thereafter.” Hearing dated 29.06.2026 4. The extracts of the RoP for the hearing dated 29.06.2026 are as under: “The learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that the present Petition has been filed seeking extension of the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date for the Petitioners’ 50 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid Project having connectivity at Fatehgarh lV ISTS Pooling Station until 28.02.2026 and consequent waiver from the payment of the ISTS Charges under Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the Sharing Regulations read with this Commission’s Office Order dated 30.07.2025 and its addendum dated 14.01.2026 and Committee’s Recommendation Report dated 26.03.2026. The learned counsel submitted that the Respondent/CTUIL has not filed any reply, and the matter may accordingly be reserved for order. 2. The learned counsel for the Respondent/CTUIL submitted that CTUIL does not wish to file any reply in the matter. 3. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, the Commission directed the Respondent/CTUIL to file an affidavit within a week clarifying whether the GNA has been made effective for the Petitioner. If yes, the date from which the GNA has been made effective and if not, the status of the transmission system which is required for making the GNA effective for the Petitioner’s Project. 4. Subject to the above, the Commission reserved the matter for order.” Submissions of CTUIL in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 29.06.2026: 5. CTUIL vide affidavit dated 07.08.2026 submitted as under: (a) The Petitioner’s Connectivity has not been made effective, and the anticipated date of effectiveness of the subject Connectivity is 28.02.2027, as per the minutes of the 38th Order in Petition No. 228/MP/2026 Page 5 14. In view of the above discussions, we are of the considered view that the Petitioner AMPIN Green’s project shall be eligible for waiver of inter-state transmission charges, as if the project had achieved COD on or before 30.06.2025 in terms of Regulation 13(2)(h) of the 2020 Sharing Regulations. 15. The Petition No. 228/MP/2026 stands disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/ Sd/ Sd/ Sd/ (Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson Order in Petition No. 228/MP/2026 CERC Website S. No. 523/2026 Page 9
